headline: Meta releases Muse Wonder and Wonder Full AI models to rival the frontier
summary: Meta launched new Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full AI models, which it says can compete with the industry's best and are larger and more capable than its earlier Muse Spark model, with higher benchmark scores on tasks like coding. The new models add features intended to keep AI agents from going off the rails.
